scope: All23 designatedDEV cases retained; no gold/image/model-outcome selection
dataset_version_semantics: version is a dataset/harness environment bucket, not a promise of matching installed package __version__

shared_parent.warning: Layer reuse is a disk optimisation only, not proof that environments are equivalent or healthy; old editable distribution metadata can point at /testbed after anotherrepo replaces its checkout

resource_constraints.disk_policy: Check C free before every source/text/package/build step; stop before crossing4GiB, do not delete protectedexperiment assets or auto-prune userimages
resource_constraints.large_images: Do not pull all23 officialinstance images by default; prefer existing sharedlayers plus exactpublicsource overlays, each with distinct imageidentity

marshmallow-code/marshmallow.strategy: Shared Python3.9/pydicom dependency layer with independent exact-source overlays; source layout is src/

public_declared_python.2.20: classifiers through Python3.7, no runtime upper bound in consulted setup.py

minimal_preparation: Fetch exact base commit publicly into an independent checkout
Install editable source with --no-deps and record actual __file__/version; do not infer import availability from inherited dist-info
Ensure pytest,pytz,simplejson,dateutil import; then collect the public tests directory
Run a small public field/serialization test file discovered from that checkout before broader baseline validation
risks: Python3.9 and pytest7 behavior remains unverified for these old commits
Tests import tests.base at conftest import time; run from /testbed, not another repository
Do not install dev/docs/lint extras wholesale; their old flake8/Sphinx pins are not runtime requirements

pvlib/pvlib-python.strategy: Prefer already prepared pvlib1707 scientific parent; exact commit overlays for each case; retain a separate legacy scientific dependency profile if public baselines expose API removals
pvlib/pvlib-python.reuse_assessment: 1707 public baseline recorded; cross-version reuse is unverified
additional_packages_to_resolve: nose for older publicly requested tests, if not present
minimal_preparation: Check whether each specified Git commit is already present without fetching bulk history
Pin NumPy below2; do not use upstream current NumPy2 with np.Inf-dependent code
Keep inherited scientific versions initially only where their public baseline actually succeeds
If old versions fail due removed pandas/SciPy APIs, record failure before proposing one fixed legacy dependency overlay; validate all same-profile cases, not only the formerly failing test
risks: Parent has NumPy1.26.4/pandas2.2.3/SciPy1.13.1: old lower bounds do not prove compatibility with these modern versions
Pandas/SciPy API removals can create environment failures on 0.7/0.8; do not misread as repair failure
Optional PySAM/netcdf/numba and remote-data tests are not proven by the pvsystem baseline
Full source data files and public package data must be retained; no replacing gold/image-unavailable cases

pydicom/pydicom.strategy: Reuse prepared pydicom1139 Python3.9/pytest7.4.4 layer and public cached fixtures, plus exact public Git overlays
pydicom/pydicom.reuse_assessment: 1139 prior and1256 current public tests recorded; other3 not validated
public_test_dependencies: NumPy/Pillow and optional codecs as required by the selected public tests

public_declared_python.1.3: consulted setup supports Python3 but classifiers only through3.6; Python3.9 not validated

minimal_preparation: Exact source/base commit overlay, then --no-deps editable install
Keep pytest<8 for legacy setup methods; no test file renaming
Check each commit public fixture hash catalogue before reusing external fixture cache; cache availability does not imply expected hash matches every version
Separate core Dataset/value representation public tests from pixel decoder/optional codec coverage
risks: pydicom1.3 may contain NumPy/Python compatibility assumptions not covered by current1139/1256 evidence
Optional codecs and downloads need separate fixed public preparation before generation
The published dataset version bucket is not the installed package __version__:1256 bucket2.1 is actual2.2.0.dev0 in current evidence
Existing public tests passed do not imply official hidden tests will pass

pylint-dev/astroid.strategy: Two small dependency profiles over the same Python3.9 parent, each case with exact source overlay
pylint-dev/astroid.reuse_assessment: 1866 validated; do not reuse wrapt1.17.3 unchanged for2.9/2.10
additional_packages_to_resolve: wrapt<1.14 for2.9/2.10, with actual LinuxCP39 wheel hash frozen before use
minimal_preparation: Reuse1866 layer for2.12+ only after same-baseline checks; exact HEAD still differs percase
Create a separate wrapt<1.14 profile for2.9 and2.10; do not satisfy dependencies by ignoring their public upper bound
typed-ast is not required by these markers on CPython3.9
Record builder versions; PEP517 declarations request setuptools~=62.6 and wheel~=0.37.1 for2.13/2.14, while the already validated build used no-build-isolation with its recorded builder
risks: 2.9/2.10 requirewrapt<1.14, incompatible with the prepared1866 wrapt1.17.3
2.14 sets filterwarnings=error; inherited dependency deprecations may fail collection or tests
AST/inference behavior is Python-version-sensitive: record3.9 rather than claim original CI coverage
Optional brain libraries/acceptance tests are not covered by builder smoke

pyvista/pyvista.strategy: One separately prepared scientific/graphics overlay, not a generic base for other repos
pyvista/pyvista.reuse_assessment: in progress; no completed4315 validation file at review snapshot
public_test_dependencies: pytest_pyvista==0.1.8 for full image-cache test workflows
additional_packages_to_resolve: Refer current pyvista4315 wheel/system preparation evidence; no duplicate download
minimal_preparation: Use already downloaded hash-verified ordinary PyPI VTK9.2.x plus minimalGL runtime if feasible under disk guard
Original OSMesa GitHub repository and wheel URL return404; do not invent historicalcommit/hash
Pin compatible older scientific versions in its own image; do not change shared parent or other repos
Nonrendering ndarray smoke only; ordinaryVTK+OFF_SCREEN does not prove headless rendering without X/OSMesa
smoke_commands: PYVISTA_OFF_SCREEN=true MPLBACKEND=Agg python -c "import ipykernel.ipkernel; import pyvista; print(pyvista.Report(gpu=False))"
risks: VTK import requires missing GL dynamiclibraries; rendering can abort without suitable X/OSMesa context
Current inherited NumPy1.26.4/Matplotlib3.9.4/Pillow11.2 violate this baseline publicrequirements
Do not set plugin-autoload-disable globally as a substitute for test dependencies
Record plotting not validated even if7 ndarray tests pass and1 public skip remains

sqlfluff/sqlfluff.strategy: Pure-Python-oriented SQL parser dependency layer shared between0.6 and0.8 only after both public baselines pass
minimal_preparation: Resolve a Python3.9 wheel lock for publicrequirements with fixed versions/hashes; do not default to newest2026 dependencies
Install exact source including entrypoints and public test fixtures; source layoutsrc/
Verify Jinja/click/plugin compatibility on both0.6 and0.8; requirements-file≥8click is stricter than0.8 metadata≥7.1
Collect public test directory from repository root; conftest imports CLI/core parser and reads localfixture directories
risks: Modern click/Jinja2/pathspec/diff-cover may satisfy loose lowerbounds but break old public APIs
0.6 uses oyaml,0.8 usesyaml; do not substitute by changing source/tests
Some wheel binaries such as regex need CP39/Linux identity; hostWindows wheel is invalid
dbt extra/plugins must be explicitly planned if a public target needs them; do not install whole dbt stack for everycase
Fixture-containing directories must be preserved, not only source package files
